The first public release of Chalkboard, a retro, offline lesson planner and assessment builder for teachers.

**Which download?**

| You have | Download |
|----------|----------|
| A Mac | `Chalkboard-1.7.0.dmg`: open it, drag Chalkboard to Applications. (`Chalkboard-macOS.zip` is the same app.) |
| Linux, or a Mac without the app | `chalkboard.pyz` + `install.sh`, then `sh install.sh` |
| Windows, or pipx/pip anywhere | the `.whl`: `pipx install chalkboard_planner-1.7.0-py3-none-any.whl` |

The Mac app isn't from the App Store, so the first time you open it, macOS asks you to
confirm in System Settings > Privacy & Security > **Open Anyway**. `Read Me First.txt`
walks through it.

**Standards:** Chalkboard doesn't include any standards. Import your state's or district's from a CSV or JSON file
(Standards Library > `I`). See [Standards files](https://github.com/themisterdragon/chalkboard#standards-files).
